Option 1: "به جز امید تو رویی ندارم - همه امید روی توست کارم". Means: "Except for hope, I have no other face; all hope is on you, my work." It expresses that hope is tied to someone (the beloved). It's about hope being directed towards someone. It expresses trust in the beloved as the source of hope.

Option 2: "دیدی که ناامیدی شد مایهٔ امیدم - تا ناامید گشتم امید من برآمد". Means: "You saw that despair became the basis of my hope - until I became disillusioned, my hope emerged." This expresses that despair gives rise to hope; hope emerges from despair.

Option 3: "نومید عشق او را امیدوار کرد - در عین ناامیدی گفتم امید من داد". Means: "Despair made his love hopeful - while in despair I said hope gave me." This seems to say that despair turned love into hope? It's a bit confusing. But concept: despair leads to hope in love. "نومید" meaning "despair" or "unhopeful". "عشق او را امیدوار کرد" meaning "despair made his love hopeful." So concept: despair transforms into hope.

Option 4: "اگر سراب ناامیدی را فلک دریا کند - آنچه اول غرق گردد کشتی امید ماست". Means: "If the mirage of despair is drowned by the sky, what first sinks is the ship of our hope."
